summary: @servicetitan/admin-sql-table preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`, and setup.mjs is a javascript-obfuscator-processed script (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, string-array dictionary lookups) that at install time downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<name>.zip into a tmpdir, extracts it, chmods it 0755, and then execFileSyncs the downloaded Bun binary against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotating string array `n7gIxM`, char-code decoder `hc1jfK9`, shuffled identifiers) shipped with no accompanying source and unreachable from any library code path — its only invocation is under the freshly-dropped Bun binary during preinstall. Fetching a second language runtime and executing an obfuscated bundle under it on `npm install` delivers full-host code execution under whatever privileges the install runs with, and specifically evades scanners that analyze only Node-resolved code. Additional context: the package is published under the `@servicetitan/*` scope with no README, empty description, and peerDependencies on internal-looking `@servicetitan/design-system`, `@servicetitan/table`, `@servicetitan/react-ioc` — shape consistent with a dependency-confusion lure impersonating a ServiceTitan internal component.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
